edited_fraction: bounded stage-wise perturbations of selected stages; fraction not stated (unclear)
cost_reported: LLM token counts and mean wall times per budget reported (tens of thousands of tokens); denominators not harmonized; no $
evidence_notes: Whole paper is LLM-guided gradient-free editing of YOLO26 (PAGE 4): local gemma4 returns a schema-checked JSON action (operation, target layer, finite coefficients within bounds), and in the hybrid arm the LLM picks a stage subspace that CMA-ES then optimizes, hence direct_values + solver_delegated. LLM hybrid did not beat a matched random-policy hybrid (paired p = 0.612/0.369/0.694) and dev gains turned negative on the selection split (PAGE 9-10); only 53/225 proposals pass the strict schema (PAGE 4, 12). Explicitly 'not a fully prospective preregistered test' (PAGE 5); code package deposit only recommended (PAGE 14); evaluation on COCO val subsets, not the full set.
